articles.title: Institutions embrace crypto staking despite shrinking yields
articles.snippet: Easier access and growing familiarity are encouraging investors to stake their tokens, while falling rewards and withdrawal delays test the economics.

articles.title: Binance hacker dumps a little-known 2017 token and it crashes 90%
articles.snippet: The hacker dumped FUN and other smaller tokens into markets too small to absorb large selling, leading to price crashes.

articles.title: XRP Ledger developers tighten the rules for who can hold 'restricted' tokens
articles.snippet: A set of fixes would tighten who can hold permissioned tokens on the network. The XRP Ledger Foundation says no users were affected.

articles.title: Binance says 90% of stolen assets replenished, targets Sunday withdrawals
articles.snippet: Less-liquid tokens make up the remaining shortfall as Binance continues buying replacement assets through market and over-the-counter trades.

articles.title: Blockchain investigator Chainalysis hit by cybersecurity incident
articles.snippet: The company said some non-sensitive customer data was exposed, including user IDs, names and email addresses.
